counting_policy: Count implemented primary families and compression formats, merging aliases and variants. Declaration families and nested structures are separate. Implementation counts are not universal format or platform qualification claims.

formats.name: Arch Linux package

formats.name: Unix ar archive
formats.profile: Bounded archive members and indexes; thin references are recorded without host-file access.
limitations: GNU/BSD ordinary archive members and GNU32/64 index declarations are read under fixed budgets.
BSD/COFF index semantics remain unread. Thin members retain references only; no external file is opened.

formats.name: SquashFS
formats.profile: Little-endian SquashFS v4.0 gzip/XZ metadata, ordinary file bytes, ID/fragment tables and link declarations, read without mounting.
limitations: Only gzip/XZ: 8 KiB metadata and 1 MiB data blocks, 16 MiB decoded metadata/fragment cache, 256 MiB per file and 512 MiB shared data decoding; XZ decoder memory is capped at 32 MiB.
Recorded real samples cover Canonical hello-world 29 (XZ) and external AppImageKit 12 (gzip); fragment and broader inode/compressor combinations retain constructed or pending native qualification.
Links, special files, xattrs/ACL effects, export lookup and runtime behavior remain declarations or explicit gaps. Other filesystem versions and compressors are unsupported.

formats.name: AppImage Type 2
formats.profile: Type 2 ELF runtime/image boundaries, captured SquashFS contents, root Desktop Entry identity and bounded literal AppRun-to-supplied-file evidence.
limitations: Ordinary ELF section tables only, capped at 8192 sections and 1024 program headers; Type 1, absent/extended section counts and unsupported layouts remain unread.
The pinned external AppImageKit 12 ELF64 little-endian/gzip image has 135 Windows 7-Zip checks and 62 Linux unsquashfs checks at a600591; other ELF classes/byte orders retain constructed tests only.

No runtime invocation or mounting. AppRun matching excludes absolute/escaping links, multiple hops, renamed/ambiguous targets and incomplete namespaces; relationships share a 16 MiB output budget. Desktop Entry Version does not establish a software release version.

formats.name: snap package
formats.profile: Canonical captured meta/snap.yaml identity, application/interface/daemon/environment/hook declarations and bounded supplied-file command/hook evidence over SquashFS.
limitations: Metadata is capped at 256 KiB per file, 16 MiB aggregate, 12000 YAML events and depth 24; duplicates, aliases, anchors, tags, merge keys and multiple documents are rejected.

Canonical hello-world 6.4 revision 29 exercises identity and four supplied application targets, with 22 Linux unsquashfs checks at a600591; other schemas and runtime profiles are not universally qualified.

Literal commands and observed hooks are evidence, not execution. No store/signature verification, installation, confinement enforcement, host lookup or symlink following; supplied-target output shares a 16 MiB budget.

formats.name: Python wheel
formats.profile: Core Metadata 2.x and Wheel 1.x identity, literal Requires-Dist/entry-point declarations and captured ZIP member inventory.
limitations: Qualified on the unchanged MIT sampleproject 4.0.0 wheel with independent ZIP/native listing checks.
RECORD hashes/signatures, installation layout, dependency markers/extras and entry-point runtime effects are not evaluated.

formats.name: Java archive family

No class loading, runtime class-path or multi-release selection, Java properties escape/legacy encoding support, signature trust or code semantics.
